description: Exact final Kohn-Sham levels (shortest round-trip decimals of `revision_ks_solver single --mermin-levels`, canonical numerics) and the root of sum g/(1 + exp((eps - mu)/T)) = N computed with mpmath at 40 significant digits (checked at 50), for the thermal states with the largest conditioning bound eps_mach [(n + 2) N/(dN/dmu) + 3 <|eps - mu|> + T (ln g_max + 3) + 2 |mu|] of the former direct count. Test input of the Rust unit test mermin::tests::forty_digit_roots and of the solver check thermo_mu_vs_40digit_roots. All numbers are strings.
